outcome: Hemoglobin difference before and after delivery
cohort: The study included 200 pregnant women at high risk for PPH undergoing vaginal delivery, randomized into two groups.
finding: Carbetocin was found to be a better alternative to traditional oxytocin in the prevention of PPH after vaginal delivery, showing lower bleeding, PPH occurrence, and need for other uterotonics, with minimal hemodynamic changes and similar side effects.
